summary: Clone Periods functionality testing completed. Backend API tests pass (13/13). Frontend UI tests show all modals and forms working correctly. Fixed 1 bug in frontend where wrong query parameter was used for periods API.
passed_tests: Admin login (admin@test.pe / test123) works correctly
GET /api/academic/years returns years with period_count
GET /api/academic/periods?academic_year_id=... returns periods for specific year
POST /api/academic/periods/clone clones periods to empty year
POST /api/academic/periods/clone fails when target has existing periods (400)
POST /api/academic/periods/clone fails when source has no periods (400)
POST /api/academic/periods/clone fails with invalid source year (404)
POST /api/academic/periods/clone fails with invalid target year (404)
POST /api/academic/periods creates new period
PUT /api/academic/periods/{id} updates period
PUT /api/academic/periods/{id} toggles active status
DELETE /api/academic/periods/{id} deletes period
POST /api/academic/years creates year without cloning
Years with periods are available for cloning in dropdown
Periods Modal opens when clicking on periods link
Periods Modal shows period name, dates, order, and active status
Add Period modal opens with form fields (Nombre, Fecha inicio, Fecha fin, Orden, Activo)
Clone Periods modal opens with year selector
Clone modal shows info about date adjustment
Dates are automatically adjusted when cloning (+N years)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: Frontend used 'year_id' query param but backend expects 'academic_year_id' in GET /api/academic/periods endpoint
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing data: Year 2026 has 4 bimestres (Bimestre I-IV), Years 2025 and 2099 have no periods.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clone Periods functionality is fully working. The feature allows admins to: 1) View/manage periods in a modal by clicking on the periods link for any year, 2) Add new periods with name, dates, order, and active status, 3) Clone periods from one year to another with automatic date adjustment. The clone endpoint validates that source has periods and target is empty. Test data: Year 2026 has 4 bimestres configured.

bugs_fixed.issue: Frontend used wrong query parameter 'year_id' instead of 'academic_year_id' when fetching periods

periods_modal.trigger: Click on periods link (e.g., '4 período(s)' or 'Sin períodos')
features: List periods with name, dates, order
Clone periods from source to target year
